# /si

Thin shortcut. The full, CLI-standalone workflow lives in the **si** skill
([SKILL.md](../skills/si/SKILL.md)) — this prompt only passes the argument through.

1. Read the si skill and note the argument after `/si`: `${input}`.
2. Run the skill end to end with that argument; an empty argument means the most recently completed plan.
